HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR  ORDER % 16.02.2023 CRL.M.A. 4190/2023 & CRL.M.A. 4191/2023
Exemptions allowed, subject to just exceptions.

1. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.448/2020, under Section 498A/406/506/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Geeta Colony, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.

2. It is submitted by the counsel for the petitioners that petitioners are the mother-in-law and elder brother-in-law (jeth) of the complainant, and there are no allegations against the petitioners in the FIR.
3. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
He seeks time to file the status report.

4. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
5. List on 17th April, 2023.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J FEBRUARY 16, 2023/ib
